style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#F9FAFB;strokeColor=#6B7280;spacing=8;rounded=1;arcSize=3;" value="<b>Rules of the parallel track</b> &nbsp; The project owner submits the documents; the reviewers decide at each gate. Each document is submitted on the day that the gate before it says Yes. If a reviewer says No, the owner revises and resubmits in 2 working days or less. <b>Hard stops:</b> no production install (11) before gate 6 says Yes; no production runs (14) and no release sign-off (15) before gate 7 says Yes. div.div: Rules of the parallel track The project owner submits the documents; the reviewers decide at each gate. Each document is submitted on the day that the gate before it says Yes. If a reviewer says No, the owner revises and resubmits in 2 working days or less. Hard stops: no production install (11) before gate 6 says Yes; no production runs (14) and no release sign-off (15) before gate 7 says Yes. Before SEND_RECORDS goes on or the judge starts (after October), gates 3, 6 and 7 examine the change again.
